Then he put fresh water in the kettle and set out two cups, just in case she was cold.","w02":"凌晨四点，值班室的灯还亮着。街道像一条暂时停下的河，只有清洁车缓缓驶过，把昨夜的喧哗收进水声里。便利店门口，一只猫守着微热的纸箱。送货人揉揉眼睛，将面包搬下车。远处的高楼偶尔亮起一扇窗，仿佛有人替整座城市醒着。天边尚未发白，早餐铺的蒸汽已经升起来了。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you reach a box with no smaller box inside."}
